verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI assistant product, and such products could plausibly offer organization workspaces with admin controls, so this axis applies. The evidence only covers individual-user capabilities (calendar, inbox, Slack, to-dos, reminders) and personal settings. It never mentions team workspaces, member management, role-based permissions, or org-level data policies. Community privacy worries are general and do not show any admin controls either way.
